svg.title: Measured optimizer comparisons
svg.desc: Three panels show final TEST cross-entropy for modular MLP, modular transformer and WikiText-2 byte transformer. Individual seeds, arithmetic means and observed ranges are retained. Negative meta-minus-baseline cross-entropy favors meta. This figure contains measured data, not confidence intervals.
svg.title: Measured optimizer comparison across three training tasks

g.text: One frozen test. Three paired seeds. Every optimizer arm.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #acb9cf

g.text: Within-task update budgets are equal. Lower loss is better; lines pair the same initialization and sampler seed.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #acb9cf

g.text: WikiText-2 uses declared byte prefixes: NLL / log(2) gives bits per byte; this is not standard word perplexity.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #acb9cf

g.text: One final TEST per logical run; 8 integrity-verification TEST repeats disclosed. Extra tuning and meta work counted; shared CPU host.
